notes.title: Bug fixes + Help button
notes.notes:
I fixed a few minor issues throughout the game, but the big ticket item in this update is a Help, Stuck button in the menu.  The game already sends me error reports and telemetry, but if you hit a situation where you think its broken (but isn't spewing errors), or you feel a room is impossible or something really weird or broken looking happened, click the Help, Stuck button.  All you have to provide is a short description of the issue.  If you give me contact info, I'll ping you to get you unblocked and with status on the fix, but that's totally optional!

Hope this helps anyone who's hitting slightly-less-bad-than-gamebreaking issues, and (as always), I hope you're having a lot of fun on the journey!
